name: Holzerhof
beschreibung: The Holzerhof occupies an elevated, sunny panoramic position in Telfes im Stubaital, surrounded by alpine flower meadows with unobstructed views of the jagged Kalkkögel limestone needles. This welcoming family-run farm features cosy guest rooms decorated in traditional timber finishes, complete with contemporary en-suite bathrooms, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and private balconies overlooking the Stubai Alps. Each morning begins with a wholesome breakfast buffet showcasing farm-fresh milk and local specialities. The nearby StuBay leisure centre, featuring swimming pools and sauna facilities, offers delightful relaxation. The base terminal of the Schlick 2000 ski and hiking area in Fulpmes is just minutes away, with ski buses also providing direct transit to the Stubai Glacier.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional farm guesthouse in a sunny hillside setting in Telfes in the Stubaital with cosy rooms and Kalkkögel views.
